name: Ofshtein Law Firm, P.C.
about: Ofshtein Law Firm is a personal injury practice headquartered on Kings Highway in Brooklyn, and it publishes offices in three states.

It states that it works on a contingency fee with nothing to pay unless the case is won, that the first consultation is free, and that it will visit clients in hospital or at home. It publishes in English, Spanish and Russian.

faq.q: How much does Ofshtein Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Ofshtein Law Firm publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Ofshtein Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Ofshtein Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. The firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home and it publishes material in Spanish and Russian.

faq.q: Where does Ofshtein Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: Ofshtein Law Firm publishes one office, in Brooklyn. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Ofshtein Law Firm?
faq.a: Ofshtein Law Firm names one attorney on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: This firm names no attorney on its public pages, so there is no roster whose licensure can be checked. The register is open and free to search; the names are what is missing.
